tools.name: create_tuvi_chart
tools.description: Builds a Vietnamese Tử Vi Đẩu Số (Purple Star) birth chart from Gregorian birth date, birth time and gender: lunar date, can chi, nạp âm, cục, the 12 palaces with their stars, and a short rule-based reading of each palace. Use when the user wants their Tử Vi chart or asks what their chart says.

tools.name: convert_lunar_solar
tools.description: Converts a date between the Gregorian calendar and the Vietnamese lunar calendar (with leap months, 1900–2100), and gives the can chi of the day, month and year plus the solar term.

tools.name: get_lunar_day
tools.description: Returns the Vietnamese lunar calendar entry for one Gregorian date (default today): lunar date, can chi, hoàng đạo or hắc đạo day, trực, lunar mansion, ages that clash with the day, taboo days and the auspicious hours.

tools.name: find_good_days
tools.description: Ranks the days of one Gregorian month for an activity (wedding, opening a shop, moving house, signing a contract, travel…) by Vietnamese day-selection rules, optionally checked against the birth years of the people involved. Returns the best days with reasons and good hours, and the days to avoid.

tools.name: check_age_compatibility
tools.description: Compares two people by birth year and gender using Vietnamese age-matching (nạp âm element, heavenly stem, earthly branch, Bát Trạch cung phi, zodiac animal) and returns a score out of 100 with each factor explained.

tools.name: find_compatible_birth_years
tools.description: For one person's birth year and gender, scores every partner birth year within a range by the same Vietnamese age-matching rules and returns the best and worst matching years.

tools.name: get_2027_forecast_by_birth_year
tools.description: Returns the traditional facts for a birth year in the lunar year 2027 (Đinh Mùi): age, relation of the birth branch and stem with the year, element relation, Tam Tai, Kim Lâu, and the yearly palace for men and women.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Searches the Vietnamese articles published on lstuvi.com about Tử Vi, palaces, stars, the lunar calendar and yearly outlooks. Returns titles, slugs and short descriptions.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Returns the summary of one lstuvi.com article by slug (from search_articles): the short answer, key points and FAQ, or the opening of the article.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns which lstuvi.com features are free and the current prices of the paid ones: detailed chart reading, couple reading, Tử Vi chat packages and coin top-up packages.
